ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_advantage_weighted_mean_loss
ir.intuition: This loss computes a pairwise margin between winning and losing log probabilities, incorporates the advantage gap as a stabilizing signal, and applies a softplus transformation. Instead of summing weighted losses, it aggregates them by a weighted mean, normalizing by the total weight. This shifts the aggregation structure to mean-based, providing a normalized scalar loss that balances contributions from all pairs and maintains stability through clamping.
ir.pseudocode:
margin = ops.sub(batch['log_prob_w'], batch['log_prob_l'])
adjusted_margin = ops.sub(margin, ops.mul(0.5, batch['advantage_gap']))
clamped_margin = ops.clamp(adjusted_margin, -10.0, 10.0)
losses = ops.softplus(ops.neg(clamped_margin))
weighted_losses = ops.mul(batch['weight'], losses)
loss = ops.div(ops.sum(weighted_losses), ops.sum(batch['weight']))
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    adv = batch['advantage_gap']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(adv))

    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    adjusted_margin = ops.sub(margin, ops.mul(0.5, adv))
    clamped_margin = ops.clamp(adjusted_margin, -10.0, 10.0)
    losses = ops.softplus(ops.neg(clamped_margin))
    weighted_losses = ops.mul(weight, losses)
    total_weight = ops.sum(weight)
    loss = ops.div(ops.sum(weighted_losses), total_weight)
    return loss
